title: ProfileV3
description: A strict, portable profile used as planner input.

created_at.description: Time this profile revision was created.

defaults.description: Profile-wide continuation defaults. Mode and output remain command-owned.

expires_at.description: Optional profile expiry; an expired profile cannot produce a plan.

metadata.description: Profile-author metadata with no execution semantics.

version.description: Profile revision chosen by the profile author.

ActionId.description: Stable identity of an action in a profile or plan.

CapabilityId.description: A bounded, non-empty capability key (for example `defender.health`).

ProfileDefaultsV3.description: Profile-wide execution defaults that never authorize mutation or output paths.

continue_on_error.description: Continue after a failed step for audit and plan operations.

ProfileStepV3.description:
One dependency-aware unit of operator-requested work.

A profile step intentionally cannot select an operation or declare its own
safety properties. The trusted planner obtains those values from its
capability registry when it derives a [`PlannedActionV3`].

continue_on_error.description: Continue after a failed step for audit and plan only. Apply always fails fast.

depends_on.description: Step identities that must complete successfully first.

step_id.description: Step identity, unique within its profile.

SchemaVersion.description: Wire version for every v3 document.
